visual_elements.description: Illustration of an industrial AC motor: gray body with cooling fins, horizontal shaft pointing right, mounting flange, and a dark terminal/connection box with cable on top. Black label 'AC Motor' sits to the right of the motor. Overlapping the motor's lower-left is a tan/beige rounded rectangle callout containing dark-red bold text 'Sin/Cos Encoder' on two lines, indicating the encoder mounted on the motor. A small mouse cursor from the screen recording is visible near this callout.
visual_elements.position: inside left green-bordered rounded rectangle, middle-left of slide

visual_elements.description: Thick solid red block arrow pointing right, indicating signal flow from the motor/encoder to the output-signal diagram. Below the arrow, two lines of red bold text: 'Sin/Cos Encoder' and 'Output Signals'.
visual_elements.position: center of slide between the two panels, ~x 35-42%, y 40-47% (text below at y 48-58%)

visual_elements.description: Circular sinusoidal encoder diagram: two interleaved sinusoidal traces wound around a circle forming a wavy/scalloped ring with 16 periods — red trace = cos, green trace = sin. Small white circle with gray outline at the center. At top, a curved double-headed black arrow above the text 'Rotation direction', with 'CCW/CW' beneath it. At upper right, red label 'cos' with a thin arrow pointing to the red wave, and green label 'sin' with a thin arrow pointing to the green wave. At bottom center, bold text 'Line count =16' with '(16 signal periods per revolution)' underneath. Two dashed black radial lines extend from the center circle to the right side spanning exactly one wave period, with a vertical double-headed black arrow at the right edge labeled 'Sin/Cos signal period'. A mouse cursor from the screen recording is visible near the left inner edge of this panel.
visual_elements.position: inside right green-bordered rounded rectangle, middle-right of slide
